TELEMETRY_PROMPT_BODY:
This mod would like to collect some gameplay data to fix bugs and balance boss fights:
for each of its boss fights, the result, act/fight, ascension, player count, boss HP, turns and the run seed — plus this mod's own error lines.

The data is saved to a [b]local file[/b] first; if the author has configured a collection server, the same anonymous data is [b]also uploaded[/b] to the author.

No personal information is collected (no Steam ID, no nickname).

You can change this anytime in Mod Config → CharacterBosses → A5. Enable it now?
